title: Observation point
description: A point of an observation series: series, subject, time, value, producer and tenant. Only code writes it: the core observe loop (source core), a job attempt through P1 obs.append since v0.2 (source job) and the core from a closed tool output field (source tool); the model never writes a point (OBV-1). Points and rollups belong to the retention class observation and are deleted by deadline in whole periods (OBV-4, RET-2).

tenant.description: Tenant of the series; a series has one (OBV-2).

task.description: The task whose records or attempt produced the point.

role.description: Role of the attempt; the core computes the evidence role_share by it (PRP-22).

acting_bot.description: The bot on whose behalf the attempt ran; the core computes author_share by it (PRP-22) and the series of the bot's own attempts (INS-5).
